The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for an order of pre- arrest bail.

2. The petitioners are the accused in crime No.1398/2023 of the Kattappana Police Station, Idukki,
registered against them to have allegedly committed the offences punishable under Sections 406 &
420 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Heard; Sri. Siraj K.H., the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and Smt. Neema T.V., the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent.

sentences.text: 4. After bestowing my anxious consideration to the facts and materials placed on record, particularly taking note of the fact that the first petitioner is a lady and she is willing to cooperate with the investigating officer for interrogation, I deem it appropriate to pass an interim order, which will do complete justice to both sides.
5. In the result, the 1st petitioner is directed to surrender before the Investigating Officer within one week from today for subjecting herself to interrogation.

After interrogation and in the event of first petitioner's arrest, she shall be released on bail on executing a bond for Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh only) with two solvent sureties each to the like sum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
This order shall remain in force for a period of three weeks.

Sd/-
